title: fix(plugin-approvals,plugin-audit,plugin-sharing): list views drop the target object's API name column beside a record pointer
body:
Fixes #24501
Clause-②: no

## Parked: draft until the console pin carries the type-half fetch

This PR stays **draft** until objectstack's `.objectui-sha` on `origin/main` has objectui `fe11eb12e578fe38cff8ba454de6507bd99daa2a` as an ancestor. That commit is objectstack-ai/objectui#13042, which answers objectstack-ai/objectui#13036. Landing this PR earlier turns the Record column of every list below into raw record ids, because the console at the current pin fetches only a list's shown columns, and the pointer cell resolves its record from the row's type half.

- **The pin today** is `4016370af3c9`, committed 2026-10-19T03:42Z. The fix was committed at 11:29Z. In the objectui clone, `git merge-base --is-ancestor fe11eb12e5 4016370af3c9` answers exit 1. The clone is shallow, so a control leg ran on the same clone: `4016370af3c9~30` (`b5153f44ea`) answers exit 0.
- **Expected-red list: empty.** No PR or merge-queue check draws these lists through the console, so nothing here turns red while the PR is parked. The parking is about what users see.
- **Unlock:** a pin bump past `fe11eb12e5` lands on `main`. This PR does not move the pin. After that: sync with `main`, re-check, ready, queue.

## What changes

`object_name` (a `Field.text` labelled "Object" that holds the target object's API name, such as `showcase_announcement`) leaves the `columns` of every list view where it sat beside its `record_id` pointer id half (`referenceVia: 'object_name'`):

| Object | Views |
|---|---|
| `sys_approval_request` | `all_requests`, `my_pending`, `submitted_by_me`, `completed` |
| `sys_approval_action` | `recent`, `all_actions` (`by_actor` never listed it) |
| `sys_audit_log` | `recent`, `writes_only`, `record_views`, `all_events` |
| `sys_record_share` | `all_shares`, `granted_to_me`, `granted_by_me`, `by_object`, `manual_grants`, `rule_grants` |
| `sys_share_link` | `active_links`, `by_me`, `revoked`, `all_links` |

- **Left as is:** `sys_audit_log.config_changes` lists `object_name` without `record_id`. Its rows (`config_change` and `import`) carry no `record_id`, so no pointer names their target. That view does not follow this pattern and is unchanged.
- `object_name` stays a declared field on all five objects. The pointer pair, its indexes, `highlightFields`, `titleFormat` and every query on the pair are untouched. Only list `columns` move.
- The Record column keeps drawing the target record (its object's icon and the record's name), once the console fetches the type half for the cell.

## Readings behind the route (seat answer `6264371362`, route A)

- **A1, the positions,** re-read on `origin/main` `de4352460`. Every view in the table lists `object_name` immediately beside `record_id`, and each object's `record_id` declares `referenceVia: 'object_name'` (request `:263`, action `:154`, audit log `:321`, record share `:172`, share link `:168`, before this diff). `config_changes` is the one view that lists the type half without the id half.
- **A2, the console half,** read from objectui `fe11eb12e5` (`git show`, read-only). Both projection builders now request the sibling. `ListView` `selectFields` adds `referenceVia` of every FLS-surviving column through `addSpeculative`, which covers ListView's own fetch. `ObjectGrid` `getSelectFields` adds a `referenceViaFields` harvest to `extraFields`, which covers the fetch a grouped grid owns (`gridOwnsGroupedFetch`) and a standalone `object-grid`. The fix is on objectui `main` (`8aa8e3e1e5`, ancestor check exit 0).
- **A3, the approvals pin:** case (f) of `approval-list-display-labels.integration.test.ts` asserted that `recent` / `all_actions` contain `object_name`, `record_id` and `acted_as_label`. It now asserts `record_id` and `acted_as_label`, and that `object_name` is absent.

## Pins

Each package now enumerates its own objects' list views. The approvals pin uses the objects `ApprovalsServicePlugin` registers. The audit and sharing pins use `objects/index.ts`. Each pin asserts two things:

1. No list view shows a `referenceVia` sibling beside its id half.
2. The family's views still show the id half, so the Record column names the target.

The pins live in `sys-approval-request-pointer-pair.test.ts`, `sys-audit-log-pointer-pair.test.ts` and `sharing-pointer-pairs.test.ts`.

**Ablation** (one `object_name` put back per package, at commit `c62273124`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode). The mutation landed each time (anchor x1 to x0, blob changed). Exactly one test went red each time, `no list view shows a referenceVia sibling beside its id half` (`expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []`; approvals names `sys_approval_request.all_requests: object_name`). The file was restored each time with blob equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`:

| Package | Mutated view | Vitest exit |
|---|---|---|
| plugin-sharing | `sys_record_share.all_shares` | 1 |
| plugin-audit | `sys_audit_log.record_views` | 1 |
| plugin-approvals | `sys_approval_request.all_requests` | 1 |

The tests import the objects by relative source path, so the ablation needed no rebuild.

## Verification, at `c62273124`

All of this ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- **Build:** the dependency closure of the three packages, then the packages themselves. Both exited 0.
- **Tests:** `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` had 81 files and 1114 tests pass; `@objectstack/plugin-audit` 56 files and 899 tests; `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` 49 files and 1163 tests. Every run exited 0.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter` with the three packages, `run typecheck`, exited 0. `check:test-typecheck` was OK for all three, and the edited test files gained no ledger entries.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gave 67 commands, and all 67 ran with exit 0.
  - Two of them first exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`): `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. After a full workspace build, both re-ran with exit 0.
  - `--ran` reports: "67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- **Declared to CI:** `test:repo`, the whole-tree families, the type-check lanes and Build Core.
- **Not measured: a browser reading of the lists.** The bundled console at the pin predates the fix. A reading against objectui `main` needs an objectui worktree build, and it belongs to the unlock, when the bundled console carries the fix.

## Acceptance notes

- **Rows without a `record_id` lose their target hint.** `sys_audit_log`'s `recent` and `all_events` also list `config_change` and `import` rows. Those carry `object_name` (`sys_setting`, `sys_platform_setting`, `sys_user`) and no `record_id`. They now show an empty Record cell, and the action column says what they are. The `config_changes` view still shows their object.
- **`sys_record_share.by_object` still groups and sorts on `object_name`.** The console fetches the grouping field, so the group header still reads the API name. That is a grouping, not a column, and it is outside this card's surface. It is reported to the seat with the next note.
- **Not in this card's surface, reported to the seat:** these record-page surfaces still name the target by its API name:
  - `sys_audit_log`, `sys_record_share` and `sys_share_link` list `object_name` in `highlightFields`.
  - `sys_record_share` and `sys_share_link` have no `nameField`, and their `titleFormat` starts with `{object_name}/{record_id}`.
